meanings: surname Xue, snow, (literary) to wipe away (a humiliation etc)
color, countenance, appearance, facial expression, pigment, dyestuff
eye, small hole, crux (of a matter), classifier for big hollow things (wells, stoves, pots etc)
to raise (animals), to bring up (children), to keep (pets), to support, to give birth
leaf of the iris, variant of 药, medicine, drug, substance used for a specific purpose (e.g. poisoning, explosion, fermenting), to poison
